[[File:EyesOfTheForce-TPM.png|thumb|right|250px|Anakin Skywalker during his Eyes of the Force testing]]
'''Eyes of the Force''' was an [[Force power/Legends|application]] of the [[The Force/Legends|Force]], often used in a regimen that trained a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] to sense images that can't be normally seen by reading the surface thoughts of others. During this regimen, an assistant held a two-dimensional image viewer so the user can't see the images being displayed on the screen. As the image viewer cycled through different images of common objects, the prospective trainee must read the surface thoughts of the assistant to determine what images were being displayed on the screen at the time. [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] used this method to test a young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] when he was brought to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

Days after the Battle of Endor, Luke Skywalker used this power to see through Wedge's eyes during the mission to Bakura.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>
